purpose: Teach: 吸着/触発/技量/施術/力説/肝炎/訪米/致死

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、薬の吸着特性を医療チームで研究しております
lines.en: Ren, we're researching the absorption properties of medications as a medical team.
lines.style: Clear, measured delivery. Direct eye contact. Steady pace. No inflection on technical terms—just facts stated with quiet authority. The tone of someone explaining her work, not selling it.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者さんを触発するメンタルケアを医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes, we handle the mental health support that inspires patient recovery as a team.
lines.style: Warm undercurrent beneath the professionalism. Slight pause after 'yes'—she's shifting from one thought to the next with care. Voice settles lower on 'patient recovery.' Not rushed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医師の技量向上のための研修を、貴院、なさってるそうですね、先生
lines.en: I hear your hospital runs training programs to improve physician skills, Dr. Saito.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, not flattery. Lean slightly forward. Tentative on the opening—he's checking if the question is appropriate. Soft respect in 'Dr. Saito.' Light pace.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、内視鏡施術の練度向上を医療チームで継続します
lines.en: Yes, we continue to develop our endoscopy procedure techniques within the team.
lines.style: Same composed baseline as before. Slight emphasis on 'continue'—this is ongoing work, not one-time. Breath between sentences. Steady gaze. Professional warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療チームから検診の重要性を力説されてますね、先生
lines.en: So the medical team emphasizes the importance of regular checkups quite strongly, I've noticed.
lines.style: Reflective observation, not a question. Soft realization in his voice. He's thinking aloud, connecting dots. Pace slows slightly. Ends with quiet conviction, like he's understood something.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、肝炎患者の治療を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes, we manage hepatitis patient treatment across the team.
lines.style: Same measured tone. Returns to clinical mode. Brief, factual. No embellishment. The word 'hepatitis' lands with quiet weight—serious condition, serious work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 国際医療会議で訪米される予定なんですね、先生
lines.en: You're planning to attend an international medical conference in the US, I understand.
lines.style: Genuine interest tinged with slight awe. He's piecing together her importance. Respectful distance in his voice. Pause before 'US'—he's thinking of the distance, the significance of the trip.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、致死量に達しない範囲での投薬を医療チームで徹底します
lines.en: Yes, we ensure medication dosing stays within safe therapeutic ranges across all team protocols.
lines.style: Slight firmness here—precision matters. Clinical language but no coldness. She's stating a principle of care. Calm authority. Ends with quiet resolve about the 'protocols.'
